caption: The video captures a calm sea meeting a sandy beach under a low sun right of center near the horizon. A bright golden reflection column runs from the sun down the water and onto the wet, glistening foreground sand. Small waves roll toward the shore, their dark crests and white foam shifting across the mid-water and wet sand edge. The sun's glittering reflection on the water shimmers and changes texture continuously as the ripples move. The bright patch reflected on the wet sand also flickers in shape and intensity. The thin foam edge left by the wash moves slightly inward and outward. The horizon, sun, and cloud layout remain constant, consistent with a stationary camera. Scattered small pebbles and shallow depressions dot the foreground sand throughout the visible motion.
